summary: Independent review accepted the byte-pinned N5 oracle after fresh Node syntax/unit checks and a focused replay of all four frozen N4 scenarios. Full parent/controller/child state, both renderer captures, build/source/helper pins, 1,134 actual DOM roots, 550 click traces, 11 capture mutations and 17 build mutations matched. All negative controls reported the targeted mutated field. Earlier N5/N6 failure evidence remains preserved.
limitations: The replay used frozen native/browser outputs; it did not relaunch Go or Chromium.
Browser clicks are programmatic HTMLElement.click() DOM dispatch, not trusted pointer or OS input.
Finite synchronous two-key profile only; no async effects are claimed.
The shared analyzer does not admit ReceiveKeyed or IsCurrent by AppIR reachability.
